exposure: type of TAPS management (conservative vs. intervention)
cohort: The study included 32 monochorionic pregnancies complicated by Twin Anemia-Polycythemia Sequence (TAPS) at a single tertiary center.
finding: Earlier diagnosis of Twin Anemia-Polycythemia Sequence (TAPS) is associated with poorer perinatal outcomes, including reduced survival and increased risk of brain injury.
gest_age: Babies were born from pregnancies diagnosed with TAPS as early as 21-27 weeks gestation and delivered as early as 30.6-32.6 weeks gestation.
